title: Garden Party Crashers
summary: Kerry has talked his way into a neighbour's garden party in North Oak as your cousin, and asks you to commit to the story while the host watches for famous faces.

start.bringUp: Kerry wants to crash a neighbour's garden party in North Oak as plus-ones, and needs V to be his cousin. Ask V to come and say they are the cousin.

variations.know: The garden party in North Oak is a costume party, and Kerry is dressed as someone you cannot quite place. The host still watches for famous faces.
variations.wants: To keep the cousin story while everyone is in costume.

variations.know: The garden party in North Oak is a charity gala with a donation table, and the host is raising money from the guests. Kerry is trying not to look like a donor.
variations.wants: To keep the cousin story at the donation table.

variations.know: The garden party in North Oak is a wedding reception, and the guests have been told that you and Kerry are with the other side of the family.
variations.wants: To keep the cousin story for the whole reception.

garden.name: the back garden of a neighbour's party in North Oak

g1.asks: What are we? Cousins? Business partners? Tell the next one the story.
g1.know: You have crashed a neighbour's garden party in North Oak with Kerry, and the host recognizes famous faces. A guest by the drinks table has just come over to talk to you.
g1.secret: He has been to this house before and was bored.
g1.wants: V to commit to a story.

stages.label: Kerry and V mingle at a North Oak garden party
stages.know: You are in the back garden of a neighbour's party in North Oak, where you are not invited. Kerry has a drink in his hand, and the host is watching for famous faces.
stages.wants: V to keep the cover story and stay away from the host.

do.who: the host, who recognizes famous faces
a guest by the drinks table

in-story.memory: You committed to the cousin story at a North Oak garden party and kept it all night.

dodge.memory: You dodged Kerry's question about who you were at a North Oak garden party, and you left early.

stood-up.memory: You did not make it to the North Oak garden party, and Kerry crashed it alone.
